name: search_documents
description: Semantic search over the full text of the catalog documents (case studies, sales decks, support guides). Use it for questions about content: context, results, how a project was done, how to use a material. Returns the most relevant passages with their source document. To list items or get links, use the catalog tools instead.

query.description: What to look for, in the user's own words.

asset_type.description: Restrict the search to one document type. One of: case_study, strategic_material, support_material. Set it whenever the user names the type (for example "case" is case_study, "deck" is strategic_material). Leave empty if unsure.

industry.description: Restrict the search to one client industry; only case studies have it. One of: Retail, Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Energy. Leave empty if unsure.

limit.description: Maximum number of passages to return (1 to 10, default 5).
